title: Closed localization unit through bounded-below Cech descent
statement:
Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal V,\mathcal Y,\mathcal Z,\mathcal B$ be topoi of sheaves on small sites with module categories over sheaves of commutative rings in fixed larger universes [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal V$, $g:\mathcal V\to\mathcal Y$, and $t:\mathcal B\to\mathcal Y$ be morphisms of ringed topoi with exact module inverse images. Let $h^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal V)\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal Z):h_*$ be a specified additive adjunction with both functors exact; write $H=h_*h^*$ and $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to H$ for its unit. All module categories are Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and use ordinary unbounded K-injective derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories].
Let $v:V\to1_{\mathcal X}$ be an epimorphism of sheaves of sets, $\mathcal X_n=\mathcal X/(V^{\times(n+1)})$ its Cech slices [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], $v_n:\mathcal X_n\to\mathcal X$ their localization morphisms, and $N$ a module sheaf on $\mathcal X$. Put $N_n=v_n^*N$ and $C_n=R(fv_n)_*(N_n[0])$, with the augmented Cech maps. There are natural identifications
$$t^*Rg_*Rf_*(N[0])\cong\operatorname{Tot}_n t^*Rg_*C_n,$$
$$t^*Rg_*H\bigl(Rf_*(N[0])\bigr)\cong\operatorname{Tot}_n t^*Rg_*H(C_n).$$
Here $H$ on derived categories is its termwise exact descent. Each totalization is computed with compatible nonnegative resolutions and the Cech alternating differential; all total degrees have finite diagonals. Under these identifications the actual map
$$t^*Rg_*\bigl(\eta_{Rf_*(N[0])}\bigr)$$
is the totalization of $t^*Rg_*(\eta_{C_n})$. The identifications preserve the augmentation and its restriction-of-sections map and are natural in $N$ and refinements of $v$. Restricting the entire displayed diagram on $\mathcal B$ to an object $U$ of its small site, using the slice site and pulled-back coefficient ring, gives the restrictions of these comparisons. The restricted arrow is $j_U^*t^*Rg_*(\eta_{Rf_*(N[0])})$, where $j_U^*$ denotes slice restriction. This assertion restricts the original unit map; it does not assert that an arbitrary additive adjunction $h^*\dashv h_*$ induces an adjunction on slice topoi. No claim about arbitrary unbounded product totalizations or about $h^*$ preserving injectives is included.

proof.text: Obtain b : PushforwardFamily for f,V,N,D from [lem-sfb-cech-pushforward-augmented-family]. Its strict augmented family has the prescribed point and canonical Cech columns. The exact inverse image fInverse with fAdj supplies exactly its hypotheses.

The specified gAdj makes g.modules a right adjoint, hence left exact. Apply [lem-sfb-exact-unit-augmented-family] to b.model, its point isomorphism, G=g.modules, T=tInverse, H=hInverse followed by hDirect, and eta=hAdj.unit. Composite exactness supplies the required H instances. This produces source and target augmented models, normalized point and total comparisons and a strict unit map.

Write L for T_D RG. Compose each source column comparison with L of b.columnIso and each target comparison with L H_D of b.columnIso. The private proved map_square_then lemma transports the four operator/refinement squares. Apply functoriality to b.augmentation to transport the two augmentation equations. Naturality of exactUnit eta at b.columnIso gives b.columnIso followed by eta on the model column = eta on the canonical column followed by H_D(b.columnIso); applying L and composing the target column comparison proves unit_columns. The point and total comparisons and their normalization equations are those already supplied. This constructs Comparison with no remaining field obligations.

For every object U of the base site, apply congrArg of (restrictDerived RB U).map to the constructed unit_total equation. By the definition of Comparison.Restricts, this is exactly the required restriction of the original arrow.
